phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Real-Time PCR (qPCR) Thermocycler is a laboratory instrument that integrates precise thermal cycling with fluorescent signal detection to enable quantitative analysis of DNA amplification in real time. It typically consists of a heated sample block, optical detection module, and control electronics to perform rapid cycling protocols and fluorescence measurement simultaneously.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: This specification reflects the most common architecture of qPCR instruments used widely in molecular biology since it combines the standard PCR thermal cycling mechanism with sensitive fluorescence detection optics and integrated control systems, which distinguishes it from traditional PCR machines and simpler thermal cyclers.
